About The Role

• Blackbaud is seeking a Senior Product Manager to join the Financial Edge NXT team. In this role, you will define product strategy, lead customer discovery, and drive the delivery of innovative SaaS and AI-powered capabilities that simplify complex financial workflows for nonprofit organizations.
• You will collaborate closely with Engineering, UX, Data Science, and Customer Success to identify customer problems, validate solutions, and deliver intelligent, data-driven experiences that create measurable customer and business value.
• What You’ll Do
• Define and execute product vision, strategy, and roadmap aligned with customer needs and business objectives.
• Lead customer discovery and translate insights into innovative product opportunities.
• Drive the development of AI-powered capabilities, intelligent automation, and data-driven experiences that improve customer productivity and decision-making.
• Partner with Engineering, UX, Customer Success, and other cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality products.
• Prioritize product investments using customer feedback, analytics, business value, and strategic priorities.
• Define success metrics, monitor product performance, and continuously optimize customer outcomes.
• Communicate product strategy, roadmap, and progress to leadership and stakeholders.
• Stay current on emerging AI technologies and identify opportunities to responsibly apply AI to solve customer problems.
• Leverage AI tools and modern product management practices to accelerate product discovery, requirements definition, experimentation, and delivery.
• Leverage AI-assisted tools to accelerate delivery and improve quality and actively experiment with emerging capabilities as they evolve.

Qualifications

• Minimum of 5 years of Product Management experience, preferably building and delivering enterprise SaaS products.
• Demonstrated experience owning products throughout the full product lifecycle, from discovery through launch and continuous improvement.
• Experience defining and delivering AI-enabled, machine learning, or intelligent automation solutions, or a strong understanding of how to apply AI to solve customer problems.
• Experience using AI tools and methodologies to enhance product discovery, roadmap planning, requirements definition, experimentation, and product delivery is highly desirable.
• Strong customer discovery, product strategy, roadmap prioritization, and analytical skills.
• Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management abilities.
• Experience working in Agile product development environments.
• Ability to influence cross-functional teams and drive strategic initiatives without direct authority.
• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; MBA or advanced degree is a plus.

Stay up to date on everything Blackbaud, follow us on Linkedin, X, Instagram, Facebook and YouTube 

Blackbaud powers social impact through purpose‑driven technology and responsible AI. Guided by our Intelligence for Good® vision, we’re building a culture where innovation, trust, and human expertise come together to help organizations make a greater difference in the world.

Blackbaud is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to maintaining an inclusive work environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, physical or mental disability, age, or veteran status or any other basis protected by federal, state, or local law.

**This position is based in Germany with hybrid or remote working options. Applicants must hold a valid work/residence permit for the respective location.**

Chaos is a leading global software company that provides world-class visualization and design solutions, empowering creative minds to bring ideas to life.

For over twenty years, Chaos has developed innovative technologies serving multiple industries, including architecture and design, media and entertainment, and product e-commerce. Chaosâ solutions help architects, designers, VFX artists/animators, and other creative professionals share ideas, optimize workflows, and create immersive experiences.

Headquartered in Karlsruhe, Germany, Chaos is a global company with offices in 11 cities worldwide. In 2022, Chaos and Enscape merged, bringing together two industry-leading companies into one. Since then, Chaos has continued to grow with the additions of Cylindo, AXYZ Design, and Evolve Lab, further expanding our expertise and solutions across architecture, design, e-commerce, and AI. For more information, please visit chaos.com.

Role Overview

The Team Lead, Education Sales leads the Education sales team and owns the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for the Education segment, covering both University and Student markets. The role is responsible for driving new institution and student customer acquisition, growing ARR within the existing base, and reducing churn across both segments. The University segment operates through direct, relationship-led sales to institutions, while the Student segment runs as a low-touch, digital-first purchase journey, requiring close partnership with the Ecommerce team to optimise the online funnel, conversion rates, and pricing experience. Reporting to the Sr. Director GTM Strategy & Transformation, this role requires a commercially driven sales leader with a hands-on approach, a track record of owning segment revenue end-to-end, and the ability to coach and develop a team while remaining personally active in deals. The role operates with a high degree of autonomy and suits someone who wants to build and scale a team rather than maintain one.

Main Responsibilities

• 
Lead and develop the Education sales team, setting clear individual performance expectations, coaching from the front, and stepping into deals directly where needed to support pipeline and attainment targets.
• 
Own and scale a proactive, discovery-led outbound motion to win new institution and student customers, continuously refining outreach cadence and qualification criteria.
• 
Drive expansion and retention within the existing student and institution customer base, identifying and executing initiatives that grow ARR and reduce churn.
• 
Own ARR and pipeline growth within the University segment through relationship-led, direct sales to institutions, tracking key performance metrics and diagnosing and correcting underperformance.
• 
Own ARR and seat growth within the Student segment, which runs as a low-touch, digital-first purchase journey rather than a traditional sales motion; partner with the Ecommerce team to continuously optimize the online funnel, conversion rates, and pricing experience.
• 
Own accurate pipeline forecasting and attainment reporting for the Education business, providing reliable visibility into performance for sales reviews and senior leadership.
• 
Partner with RevOps, Marketing, Product, and Ecommerce to ensure Education-specific campaigns, content, and product feedback are prioritised and executed effectively.

Required Experience

• 
At least 5 years of sales experience within a SaaS or technology environment, including demonstrated experience leading a sales team with direct accountability for team performance and revenue outcomes.
• 
Proven track record of owning a direct sales territory or segment end-to-end, from pipeline generation through closed, retained revenue.
• 
Experience managing and influencing a low-touch, digital or ecommerce-led purchase journey (funnel, conversion, pricing) is a strong advantage.
• 
Previous experience in Architecture, Education, EdTech, or a related vertical is an advantage, but not required.

Required Skills

• 
Takes full ownership of commercial outcomes: builds pipeline, closes deals, and drives team performance without waiting to be directed.
• 
Leads by example in the field: comfortable coaching team members through live deals and personally engaging in high-priority opportunities where it makes a difference.
• 
Translates ARR and revenue data into clear, defensible strategy, is able to identify where performance is off track, diagnose the root cause, and act on it.
• 
Communicates with credibility at senior level: presents team results, forecasts, and strategic needs clearly to VP-level and cross-functional stakeholders.
• 
Able to build effective working relationships and collaborate cross-functionally across Ecommerce, RevOps, and Marketing: driving digital funnel and conversion improvements for the Student segment without direct authority.
• 
Operates effectively with high autonomy in a fast-moving environment: sets own priorities, creates momentum without close direction, and holds a consistently high personal bar for execution and results.
• 
Familiarity with MEDDICC or a similar sales qualification framework is an advantage.

We welcome people who value teamwork, stick to their commitments and are curious to explore new ways for achieving mastery. If you believe that you are a good match for the job, just send us your CV in English.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Confidentiality of all applications is assured.
